title: [3.2.0-beta1] Profile helper 'Clone' reports Error in IC Values
symptom: When cloning an existing working local profile, the cloned profile (DefaultProfile) shows invalid entries in basal rate fields and reports 'Error in IC Values' when selected.
cause: The cloned profile is not a clone of the active profile; it is a default profile with out-of-range entries to force the user to enter their own values.
fix: The user should not clone the active profile; instead, they should manually enter their own profile values. The default profile is intentionally invalid to prevent accepting default values.
evidence_quote: So it's not possible to clone the active profile, and the default profile has out-of-range entries to force the user to enter their own profile rather than accepting a default value.
